description.title: תנאי פוליסת אחריות מקצועית
description.summary: This table details special conditions related to loss prevention expenses under a professional liability insurance policy. It outlines the insurer's indemnity for actions taken to prevent claims, subject to specific requirements.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת תנאים מיוחדים הקשורים להוצאות מניעת הפסדים במסגרת פוליסת אחריות מקצועית של הראל. הפוליסה מכסה הפסדים ישירים כתוצאה מפעולות שננקטו על ידי המבוטח למניעת תביעה, בתנאי שהנסיבות ידווחו מיד למבטח וכל פעולה מתקנת תאושר מראש. פוליסת אחריות מקצועית של הראל מספקת כיסוי עבור סעיפים I, II, III ו-IV, וכן הוצאות מניעת הפסדים. תנאים אלו מגדירים את גבולות האחריות של המבטח ואת חובת ההוכחה של המבוטח. ההראל ביטוח חברה בע״מ היא המבטח.
notable_values: Liability Limit: Based on original paragraphs I, II, III, IV

sketch:
Special Conditions to Part 1
1. Loss Prevention Expenses
The Insurer shall indemnify the Assured for direct loss suffered by them as the result of action taken by the Assured in preventing a claim that would, if made, have been covered under paragraphs I, II, III and IV above, provided that:
The circumstances shall upon discovery be immediatelly reported to the Insurer.
Any corrective action shall be with the prior approval of the Insurer, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld.
That the liability of the Insurer hereunder shall not exceed that which would otherwise have arisen under paragraphs I, II, III, IV.
That the burden of proving that liability would otherwise have existed shall rest upon the Assured.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת אחריות מקצועית
This table details special conditions related to loss prevention expenses under a professional liability insurance policy. It outlines the insurer's indemnity for actions taken to prevent claims, subject to specific requirements.
ממדים: Special Conditions to Part 1, Details of Loss Prevention Expenses

Special Conditions to Part 1
1. Loss Prevention Expenses
The Insurer shall indemnify the Assured for direct loss suffered by them as the result of action taken by the Assured in preventing a claim that would, if made, have been covered under paragraphs I, II, III and IV above, provided that:
The circumstances shall upon discovery be immediatelly reported to the Insurer.
Any corrective action shall be with the prior approval of the Insurer, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld.
That the liability of the Insurer hereunder shall not exceed that which would otherwise have arisen under paragraphs I, II, III, IV.
That the burden of proving that liability would otherwise have existed shall rest upon the Assured.
